item.title: AHICE Asia Pacific 2026: networking events expanded, can’t miss farewell event added
item.description: Delegates at this year’s Asia Pacific Hotel Industry Conference and Exhibition (AHICE) Asia Pacific in Adelaide from 5-7 May will be treated to an exceptional line-up of networking experiences and exclusive events, including a can’t-miss rock concert to conclude the conference. The post AHICE Asia Pacific 2026: networking events expanded, can’t miss farewell event added appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Design INN Asia attracts global crowd in Singapore
item.description: The second annual Design INN Symposium Asia attracted over 300 of the region’s leading designers, suppliers, hoteliers and investors as part of AHICE South East Asia in Singapore this week (Mat 10-11), an event which looked at the leading trends in the industry at present. The post Design INN Asia attracts global crowd in Singapore appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: AHICE South East Asia takes centre stage in Singapore with over 600 in attendance
item.description: The leading investors, owners, developers, hoteliers, advisers and suppliers from across South East Asia are in Singapore this week (Mar 10-11) with AHICE back in the city over two action packed days. The post AHICE South East Asia takes centre stage in Singapore with over 600 in attendance appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Foxtel Business partners with eero to bundle Wi-Fi for accommodation sector
item.description: Foxtel Business iQ will now offer accommodation customers access to advanced Wi-Fi solutions, under a new deal with eero, an Amazon company. The post Foxtel Business partners with eero to bundle Wi-Fi for accommodation sector appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Industry backs new national program aimed to support workforce shortages
item.description: The travel industry has launched a new initiative to bridge the first-job-gap for school leavers, while addressing the travel sector’s workforce shortage challenges. The post Industry backs new national program aimed to support workforce shortages appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Hotel sector ‘realigns’ following record performance and investment growth
item.description: Claims of a realignment of the Australian hotel sector driven by foreign investment has been revealed in the latest CBRE report. The post Hotel sector ‘realigns’ following record performance and investment growth appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: Amora moves into next phase of growth
item.description: As its first 4.5-star contemporary offering in the Australian market, this month’s Amora Herencia launch marks a new chapter for Amora Hotels and Resorts. The post Exclusive: Amora moves into next phase of growth appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: New chapter: Mandarin Oriental makes luxurious debut in the Netherlands
item.description: The Conservatorium Hotel has officially begun a new chapter as Mandarin Oriental Conservatorium, Amsterdam, under the management of Mandarin Oriental. The post New chapter: Mandarin Oriental makes luxurious debut in the Netherlands appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Beckons launches in strategic move to band Baillie Lodges and Tierra Hotels
item.description: In a brand evolution for Baillie Lodges and Tierra Hotels, Beckons has been unveiled as the new global hospitality brand uniting both portfolios as a new era unfolds for the experiential tourism sector. The post Beckons launches in strategic move to band Baillie Lodges and Tierra Hotels appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Mandala secures management of Merchant Hotel, first Radisson Individuals in Queensland
item.description: Mandala Hotels and Resorts has signed the management agreement for The Merchant Hotel, part of Radisson Individuals, ahead of its May opening. The post Mandala secures management of Merchant Hotel, first Radisson Individuals in Queensland appeared first on Hotel Management.
